tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄༅// ring 'tsho'i cho ga sgrub pa'i rnam par bzhag pa 'chi bdag slu ba'i rtog pa'i don 'grel tshe dbang dga' ba 'khyil pa'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī bantu/ rab mdzes zla ba zhun ma'i thig le ni// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bsil zer 'dzag pa yis// dus kyi mun pa bsnyil nas rtag brtan gyi// lang tsho rgyas mdzad lhag pa'i lha des skyongs// mtho ris rten bzang lha yi dga' tshal na// tshe mchog dpal gyi 'dab ma yid 'ong ba// sde bzhi'i snye ma'i phud bus dud pa der// thar pa'i longs spyod dbyar gyi sman ljongs bzhin// de bas na brjod bya dang dgos sogs kyi 'brel pa dang ldan pa 'di 'chad pa la spyi don rnam pa bcu gsum gyis bstan te/ tshe'i ngo bo/ mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ dbye ba/ 'tsho 'chi'i bye brag 'chi ba'i ltas/ 'tsho thabs kyi cho ga rgyud sgrub thabs kyi mdor bstan/ cho ga'i 'brel/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i shes byed/ myur du 'bad par gdams pa/ 'tsho ba'i dgos pa/ tshe sgrub pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ mdzod las/ srog ni tshe yin drod dang ni// rnam shes rten gang yin pa'o// zhes drod dang rnam shes rgyun chags su gnas pa'i rten nam rgyur gyur cing*/ las kyi rnam par smin pa la brten pa/ ming gi rnam grangs su srog gi dbang po zhes kyang bya ba ste ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed du bzhed do// gnyis pa ni/ dper na/ mda' 'phangs pa'i shugs sam/ sa bon btab pa'i dus kyi 'phen pas ji srid sa la lhung ba dang*/ 'bras bu smin pa'i bya ba grub kyi bar du 'gro ba dang*/ smin pa'i bya ba byed pa bzhin du/ las kyis ji srid 'phangs pa de srid du 'tsho zhing gnas pa'i rang bzhin can no// gsum pa la gnyis/ tshe dang srog go /dang po ni/ 'dod 'jo las/ gson pa'i las kyi dus la// ā yuḥste i ṇa las ṇi ta'o zhes pas u si'o// zhes pa ltar i ṇa 'gro ba'i byings la u cha sogs kyi u si sbyar/

ṇi ta bzhin tu bsgrub pas/ ā yuḥtshe zhes grub pa ni 'tsho ba'i dus la 'gro ba'i las brjod pa ste tshe skabs kyi don no// gnyis pa ni/ de las/ 'dis rab tu 'gro ba'i phyir prā ṇaḥste aṇa las ghanya'o// zhes pa dang*/ yang na las la a ṇa sbyar ba'ang bshad cing*/ srog ces bya ba rlung chen po/ kha dang sna nas rgyu bar byed// ces pa ni snying gi rlung nyid brjod pa la rab tu sbyar ba ste srog rlung gi rnam grangs ni ma yin no// zhes prā ṇaḥ'i sgra rab tu 'gro ba ste rtag tu phyi nang du rgyu ba'i las byed pas sam 'tsho ba'i dus ji srid du 'gro ba ste srog gam snying gi rlung la 'jug gi/ bye brag srog 'dzin gyi rlung tsam kho na'i skabs don ma yin zhes pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ chos mngon pa las/ srog gi dbang po gang zhe na khams gsum pa'i tshe yin no zhes pas ngo bo la dbye ba byar med kyang*/ rnam pa'i ldog pa'am/ rten dang brten pa'i bye brag las brtsams te dbye na gsum/ mdo lugs/ sngags lugs gtsug lag las 'byung ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ ldog pa dang*/ rten no// dang po ni/ sngon las kyis lus rten der tshe ring thung ji tsam zhig 'phangs pa'i srog gi rgyun ris mthun gnas par 'gyur ba de ni tshe'i 'du byed yin cing*/ da lta'i las sam byed pa'i 'bras bus dus ji srid bar 'tsho ba de ni srog gi 'du byed do// mdo las bcom ldan 'das kyis/ srog gi 'du byed dag byin gyis brlabs nas sku tshe'i 'du byed dag btang ngo zhes pas gsal lo// zhes mngon pa ba bzhed do// gnyis pa ni/ tshe'i rten drod dang rnam shes yin la/ de dag gi rten kyang tshe yin pas phan tshun ltos nas 'jug pas drod dang rnam shes kyi rten gnyis so// sems dang yid kyi cha nas dbye ba byar med de/ sems dang yid dang rnam shes ni// don gcig ces 'byung bas so// gnyis pa sngags kyi lugs ltar na/

dri med 'od las/ dbu mar srog gi rlung brten par byas pas tshe dang nad med pa ster ro// zhes 'byung ste/ 'di la gsum/ rtsa dang rlung dang thig le'o// dang po ni/ de nyid las/ byang chub kyi sems myu gur gyur pa snying ga'i go skabs rnams su rnam pa bcu'i rtsa srog la sogs pa'i rlung rnams kyi rten du 'gyur te/ de dag kyang shin tu phra ba ste skra'i tshad tsam mo// zhes pas khams drug ldan gyi gang zag gi dbang du byas te 'khor lo drug po'i bar na rang sor phyed dang bcu gsum gyi tshad ldan kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa'i rten srog chen po'i rlung gis gang nas gnas pa stong sang nge ba nam mkha' dwang ba lta bu a ba dhū ti dang su su ma sogs ming gi rnam grangs mang po dang ldan la srog rten pa'i cha nas srog gi rtsa zhes grags shing*/ ji srid 'khor lo'i dbu ma'i 'pho ba'i rtsa bcu gnyis su rlung dang byang chub kyi sems 'bab pa de srid du 'tsho ba zhes bya ba rab tu grags so// gnyis pa ni/ gsang ba 'dus par/ dang po'i mgon po de nyid zhe sdang rdo rje zhal gsum par 'gyur te/ zhes pa'i don/ gang gi tshe mngal du kun gzhi'i rnam shes zhugs pa de'i tshe nyon mongs pa can gyi yid 'du byed pa langs pas dkar dmar gnyis kyi dwangs ma las srog rlung a'i rnam pa chags nas zla ba bcu la rlung bcu 'phel te da lta lus dang 'tsho ba'i rgyun gnas par byed cing ji srid 'phel 'grib med par rtsa thams cad du rlung rgyu ba de srid du 'tsho zhing 'chi ba'i ltas mi 'byung ba yin no// gsum pa ni/ sdom 'byung las/ spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo na// padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i gzugs// phra ba byang chub sems kyi gnas// thams cad rten pa'i gzugs yin pas// byang chub snying po'i ngo bo nyid// ces sogs gsungs pa kun gzhi dang srog gi rlung rten byed pha ma las thob pa'i dkar cha haṃ dang dmar cha a thung gi rnam pa dbu ma'i yar mar gyi sna rtser gnas pa la brten nas dwangs ma bcu gnyis dang snyigs ma nyer bzhi rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su thim longs spyod bdag po'i tshul gyis

phra ba'i rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ gtso mo nyer bzhi rnams la rlung khrag 'bab pa'i longs spyad zin thim pa/ da lta ba longs spyod/ 'byung khungs bdag po ste rtsa yi rtse sked rtsa ba gsum la sbyar dgos zhes gsungs/ 'bab pa ste thig le ji tsam rgyas pa de tsam du tshe dang bsod nams la sogs pa 'phel ba yin no// gsum pa gtsug lag las 'byung ba ltar na bzhi/ mdangs dang*/ bla dang*/ khrag dang*/ drod do// dang po ni/ yan lag brgyad pa las/ gang zhig 'jigs pas 'jigs 'gyur zhing*// gang zhig lus can 'tsho byed pa// snying la gnas dang khyab gyur gang*// de ni srog gi gnas mchog yin// zhes 'byung ba ltar kha zas kyi dwangs ma lus zungs bdun po'i mthar phyin pa mdangs kyi mchog ces bya ba lus kun la khyab cing tshe ring du gnas pa'i rten du gyur ba gang yin pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ srog gam tshe gnas pa'i rten ngo bo tshe srog gi dris bgos pa bla rtsa'i nang nas srin lag brgyud de phyi rol du 'khyams pa las/ mi de dbang thang zhan na mtshan mor rgyu ba'i 'byung po rnams kyis bdag tu bzung nas longs spyod pa las bla 'khyams pa dang 'phrog pa brkus pa sogs zer zhing rten bla la gnod pas brten pa tshe srog la'ang gnod par 'gyur ba de nyid brten pa'i rtsa la'ang bla rtsa zhes grags te/ ji skad du/ sems la rang dbang ma thob phyir bltas pas// ma rig srid pa'i lus ngan blangs pa yis// tshe srog rten du bla rtsa 'khyams po byung*// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ de la sems can rnams kyi 'tsho ba ni khrag la rag las pa yin te khrag legs par gnas shing rgyu na ni srog kyang legs par gnas pa yin no// zhes so// bzhi pa me drod ni/ pho ba der ma zhu ba'i gnas la brten te de nas tshe dang stobs dang gzi mdangs 'byung ba chen po lnga'i dwangs ma dang khams bdun po 'phel zhing rgyas par byed do zhes srog 'tsho ba'i gtso bor bshad cing mngon pa nas gsungs pa'i drod dang gnad gcig go

/'di dag la brten nas tshe gnas pa dang mi gnas pa'i 'gro ldog byed pas rnam grangs kyi dbye bar rung ste/ lus dang srog gnas pa'i rtsa bar byed pas rtsa zhes pa lta bu bdag nyid gcig pa dang rten brten pa'i 'brel par grub cing*/ 'di la brten nas tshe gnas pa'i rkyen dang 'chi med grub pa'i gnad sogs kyang zhar las shes par 'gyur ro// lnga pa la gsum/ 'tsho ba'i khyad par/ 'chi ba'i bye brag glo bur 'chi ba yod med bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ sngags dang bcud len gyis rig pa 'dzin pa grub pa dang*/ rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i bsam gtan dngos gzhi thob pa dang*/ sems med snyoms 'jug dag ni 'phen pa ma rdzogs bar du 'tsho ba mi 'dor la/ rgyal chen ris bzhi'i lha rnams mi lo sa ya dgu 'tsho ba nas gong du 'phel te srid rtse ba rnams bskal chen brgyad khri'i bar du 'tsho ba dang*/ dmyal ba'i tshe tshad thung shos kyang mi'i lo grangs kyis gzhal bar dka' zhing ring shos bskal pas gzhal du med la/ yi dwags mi lo sa ya gcig dang dgu 'bum/ dud 'gro ring mtha' bskal pa nas thung mtha' skad cig ma'i bar ma nges par 'tsho ba dang*/ sgra mi snyan na tshe stong ste// gnyis na phyed phyed spangs pa'o// 'di na ma nges tha mar ni// lo bcu dang po dpag tu med// ces pas mi'i 'jig rten byang gling pa lo stong*/ nub gling lnga brgya/ shar gling pa gnyis brgya lnga bcur nges pa can tu 'tsho la/ lho gling 'dir ni thung mtha' tshe lo bcu dang*/ ring mtha' bskal pa dang po'i mi rnams tshe lo dpag med 'tsho la/ deng sang tshe lo sum cu'am nyi shu kha ral ba'ang bzhed pas/ zhi ba lhas/ de ring sang tsam mi 'chi zhes// bde bar 'dug pa rigs ma yin// ces dang*/ tshe ni yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang*// tshe yi tshad kyang ji tsam mi shes pas// ngang pas chu las 'o ma len pa bzhin// rang gi 'dod pa dang du blang bar byos// zhes gsungs pa ltar tshe'am chos sogs bsgrub bya la phyi gshol ma song ba kho na gces so// spyir dge ba'i las kyis tshe ring zhing bde bar 'tsho pa yin mod kyi/

ngan 'gro rnams ni mi dge ba'i las kyis sdug bsngal myong ba'i yun shin tu ring bar grub pas las la yid ches par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ dper na/ mar me ni res 'ga' sdong bu zad pas dang*/ res 'ga' 'bru mar zad pas dang*/ res 'ga' gnyis ka zad pas dang*/ res 'ga' gnyis ka ma zad kyang rlung la sogs pas 'chi ba bzhin tu tshe zad pas 'chi la bsod nams zad pas ma yin pa dang*/ de las ldog pa dang*/ gnyis ka yin pa dang*/ gnyis ka ma yin pa ste mu bzhi las/ dang po ni/ las kyis 'phangs pa'i srog gi rgyun rdzogs pas 'chi ba dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ longs spyod kyi rnam smin can gyi las zad pas 'chi ba dang*/ gsum pa ni/ tshe dang longs spyod kyi rnam smin can gyi las gnyis ka zad pas 'chi ba dang*/ bzhi pa ni/ de gnyis ka ma zad kyang bag med pa'i spyod pa dang g.yul dang me chu sogs ya nga ba mi spong bas 'chi ba'o// des na mu dang po'i phyir srog skyob pa dang*/ mchod rten bzhengs pa sogs rgyu mthun gyi dge ba rnams dang*/ gnyis pa'i phyir dkon mchog mchod pa sogs bsod nams kyi bya ba spyi dang*/ gsum pa'i don du gnyis ka la 'bad de 'chi ba bslu zhing*/ bzhi pa'i ched du zas dang spyod lam kun la bag yod pa bya ba dang*/ ya nga ba'i gnas rnams rnam pa kun tu spang*/ mo bon sman la sogs pas kyang phyi ma 'di tsam la phan gdags su rung gi snga ma gsum la ni de dag gi mthu 'jug pa ma yin no// dkar po'i rgyu de dag gzhir bzhag pa'i steng du sngags kyi bskyed rdzogs zab mos tshe sgrub pa ni bzhi ka la gces te bu lon ma khug pa'i dbul po gnyen khas drag gis mgon nas nor dang sprad pa lta bu'o// gsum pa la gnyis dngos dang rgyu'o// dang po ni/ mdzod las/ sgra mi snyan ma gtogs par 'chi// zhes pas dmigs bsal kha cig ma gtogs 'dod khams pa snyoms 'jug gnyis la ma zhugs pa rnams ni bar 'chi dang bcas pa ste/

de dag gi lus la gnod pa byas pas tshe la gnod par 'gyur ba'i phyir tshe lus kyi rgyud la rags lus par 'jug pa zhes glo bur dang bcas pa yin la/ sgra mi snyan pa ni tshe tshad rings por 'tsho yi bar 'chi med la/ de bzhin tu/ tshe lan cig skyes nas gnas pa zhes 'gog pa dang 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug gnyis dang byams pa sogs ting nge 'dzin thob pa'i 'dod khams pa dang*/ gzugs gzugs med kyi sems can byang sems skye ba gcig gis thogs pa dang*/ tshe de nyid la dgra bcom thob pa'i srid pa tha ma pa rgyal bas tshe tshad lung bstan pa/ rgyal ba'i pho nya/ mthong lam dang byams pa chen po la zhugs pa/ byang sems srid tha pa dang 'khor los sgyur rgyal/ de dag lhums na yod pa'i yum la sogs pa ni rang rang gi tshe tshad dam bya ba'i 'bras bu ma grub kyi bar du glo bur 'chi ba med do// gnyis pa ni/ de la dmyal ba pa rnams ni rgyal ba'i thugs rje dang rgyud la dge sems skyes pa sogs dkar po'i mthu yis glo bur du 'chi ba'i rgyu byed la/ lha dang lha min g.yul sprod pa dang rtsed mos myos pas mtshon gzhan dag ni mi dge ba'i bsam sbyor dang bag med pa kho nas glo bur du 'chi ba'i rgyu rkyen byed pa dang*/ khyad par mi'i 'jig rten du 'jigs pa chen po bcu drug tu grags pa ni/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud las/ dgra dang seng ge glang chen dbang po me dang lto 'phye'i bdag po chom rkun zhags pas 'ching pa dang*// chu gter 'khrugs pa dang ni sha za 'chi ba'i 'jigs byed nad dang dbang po'i nye bar 'tshe ba dang*// dbul dang bud med bral dang mi bdag 'khrugs pa'i 'jigs pa dang ni rdo rje ltung dang don nyams pa// zhes pa ltar la/ 'jigs pa glo bur ba de dag sngags la sogs pa'i mthus bzlog par 'gyur ba'i tshul yang*/ de nyid las/ gang zhig rnal 'byor ma rnams zhabs ni nyin zhag so sor dran byed de la rab tu nyams par 'gyur// zhes so/

mdo las glo bur du 'chi ba'i rgyu dgur gsungs te/ zas mi 'phrod pa za ba/ zas 'grangs kyang mang du za ba/ snga ma ma zhu phyi ma za ba/ bshang gci dus su mi 'dor ba/ nad pas sman pa dang nad g.yog la mi nyan pa/ gdon drag pos btab pa/ skyugs sman log pa/ ma brtags pa'i drag shul spyod pa/ bag med par 'khrig pa spyod pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig tu grags pa sogs mang yang de dag tu ma 'dus pa med la/ mdor na de dag ma byung ba'i snga rol nas bsrung ba dang spang ba la mkhas par bya ba ni tshe ring por 'tsho ba'i cho ga phul du byung ba'o// drug pa la gnyis/ 'chi ltas 'byung ba'i rgyu brjod/ 'chi ltas bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po la gsum/ phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'o// dang po ni/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ lha dang 'byung ba gnyis ka ni// 'khrugs pa 'chi ba'i mtshan nyid gsum// thob las 'chi ltas 'byung 'gyur bas// 'di las dbye ba mtshon par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar gsum dang*/ de re re la'ang phyi dang nang gi dbye bas gnyis gnyis su 'gyur te/ lha 'khrugs pa'am lha las gyur pa la thog lhung ba sogs phyi dang*/ mu ge sogs nas 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'am 'byung ba las gyur pa la me chu sogs kyis 'tshe ba phyi dang*/ rlung mkhris sogs 'khrugs pa nang*/ lha dang 'byung ba gnyis ka 'khrugs pa la'ang phyi dang nang gi dbye bas drug tu 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ni/ rang rang gi khams 'tsho ba'i rgyu tshe'i 'phen pa dang*/ sngon nas bsags pa'i las kyi lhag ma dang*/ bsod nams kyi mthu gsum las gang rung zad pa ste rkyang zad gsum dang*/ de dag gnyis gnyis zad pa dang*/ lhan cig tu zad pa ste gsum ka'ang sngon bsags las kyi 'phen pa la rags las shing*/ 'phral rkyen gyi 'gro ldog la'ang nges par ltos te/ snga 'gyur gyi rgyud las/ dam nyams sems dkrugs yi chad dngangs pa dang*// zhe sdang drag pos rbod gtong tshar bcad dang*// sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa dang*// gnas ngan dag tu gnas phab 'di dag ni// tshe nyams dbugs dngangs bgegs kyi dbang du 'gyur// zhes tshe 'dzad pa'i rkyen dang*/

ngag dbang grags pas/ rkun ma nya dang ri dwags sbrul// bya sogs srog la chags pa rnams// 'di dag bsad na 'phral du ni// tshe ring ba yang tshe thung 'gyur// zhes srog gcod sogs rang bzhin dang bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba 'phel bas rnam par dkar ba'i las kyi 'phro rdzogs pa'i rkyen dang*/ mchod rten 'jig pa dang dge 'dun gyi chos 'khor 'joms pa sogs bsod nams ma yin pa'i las kyis bsod nams 'dzad pa'i rkyen byed pas/ las kyi 'phen pa zad na dus kyi 'chi ltas dang*/ rkyen gyi dbang las dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ltas 'byung ba'i rgyu byed cing*/ tshe dang las dang bsod nams gsum po'ang mar me dang sdong bu dang mar khu bzhin du gcig la gcig brten te ring du 'tsho bar byed do// gsum pa ni/ rang rang dbugs kyi grangs nyi khri chig stong drug brgya la nyin zhag re rtsis pa'i lo brgya na rtsa rlung thig le gsum po sdud pa'i rim las dus kyi 'chi ltas 'byung la/ rkyen glo bur ba'i dbang gis g.yas g.yon nyi zla'i rgyu ba yon po shugs cher 'phel zhing lte bar khyim/ snying gar thun brgyad/ mgrin par rgyu skar/ spyi bor zla rkang gi rim pa rnams yun thung ngus 'dor ba las dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ltas 'byung ba yin no// 'di ni rgyas par spro na mtha' yas pas gsang sngags kyi rgyud lung man ngag rnams las rtogs dgos so// gnyis pa la drug yul gang la brtag tshul ji ltar brtag dus nam gyi tshe brtag ltas kyi 'brel brjod/ ltas ji tsam 'byung ba la dpyad/ brtags pa'i dgos pa'o// dang po ni/ 'chi bdag bslu ba'i rtog pa las/ gal te 'ga' zhig 'chi ba yi// mtshan nyid shes par 'dod gyur pa// des ni bder gnas lus las ni// shes bya gzhan du yid gnyis 'gyur// khams mi snyoms dang 'dod chags dang*// rab rib la sogs mthu las dang*// 'jigs dang mya ngan sogs kyi mthus// gang las gzhan tu so sor snang*// zhes pa ltar ro// gnyis pa la gzhung lugs man ngag rnams su dbye bsdu du ma mchis kyang mdor bsdu na gnyis te phyi dang nang gi ltas so// dang po la drug ste/

karka ṭa dang chu srin gyi 'pho ba'i nyin zhag gi nyin gung rang grib 'phel 'grib go ldog pa'am tshad las 'das par 'grib pa ni 'chi ba'i ltas dang*/ tshad las 'das par 'phel ba nad kyis 'tshe ba'i ltas te de sogs grib ma la brtag pa dang*/ rkang mthil dang lte ba phrug snyam byed na nyin zhag gsum gyi gong du lnga bar 'gyur ba sogs glo bur zug rngu la brtag pa dang*/ bshang gci'i mnyam por sgrid pa byung ba/ dkar po'i tshes gcig la khams nag por 'bab pa/ ri rab kyi du ba/ rna ba'i utta/ rgyal mo'i 'od mdangs/ tshangs pa'i skud pa chad pa sogs lus la brtag pa dang*/ mig gis gzugs dang rna bas sgra sogs yul rnams tshul ldan du mi 'dzin pa'am log par 'dzin te 'khrul pa sna tshogs su myong ba sogs dbang po la brtag pa dang*/ sprin med nam mkhar snga dro phyi dro'am/ yang na zla 'od du rang gi grib mar yun ring bltas pa'i grib gzugs nam mkhar mthong ba la skyon yod med brtag pa ste grib gzugs la brtag pa dang*/ rtsa sdud cing rlung yon por rgyu ba dang rtsa gnas su gdon zhugs te nad drangs pa'i rkyen las mun rug nyi zla nub pa dang*/ rgyan gos phreng ba dmar po thogs pa/ gcer bur 'khyams pa/ bong bu la zhon nas lho phyogs su 'gro ba sogs tshe nyams pa/ bla 'khyams pa/ nyes pa gsum dang 'dus pas glo bur du 'chi ba'i ltas so sor snang ba'i rmi lam la brtag pa rnams te/ rgyas par ni 'chi bslu'i rtog pa sogs las shes par bya'o// gnyis pa ni rlung la brtag pa ste de la gnyis/ spyi dang khyad par ro// dang po ni/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ ma rig chu srin ro hi ta// zhes gsungs pa ltar rten 'brel dang sbyar ba'i dbang gis rgyal zla'i 'pho ba thog mar byas te nad med tha mal du gnas pa'i skyes bus rlung gi 'pho ba brtag ste/ de'ang dkar phyogs tshes gcig nas brtsams/ nyi ma gsum du nangs par nam langs nas thun phyed bar zla ba'i rlung thog mar byas te rgyu/

de nas nyin gsum nyi ma'i rlung thog mar byas te rgyu ba sogs res mos su rgyu ba la 'pho 'phyug med na tshe rang bzhin du gnas shing*/ gal te nyi ma lnga drug tshun chad phyin ci log tu rgyun rtsod pa dang mya ngan la sogs pa'i kha smra 'byung*/ phyogs gcig log na nad mi bzad pas theb/ phyogs gnyis log na grogs po nye du rgud/ phyogs gsum du go ldog pa dang*/ kha sna gsum ka nas rgyu ba/ mnyam rgyu zhag bcu'i bar du mi 'pho ba/ thun phyed gcig la'ang lan mang du 'pho ba/ kha gcig pu nas rgyu ba sogs ni gdon mi za ba 'chi ba'i ltas so// mgo tha skar/ gro bzhin/ snron/ nag pa/ mchu zla drug po'i khyim 'pho nas brtsams te nyi ma lnga lngar nyi ma'i rlung kho na rgyu na rim bzhin lo bco brgyad/ bco lnga/ bcu gnyis/ dgu/ drug lo gsum gyi 'og tu 'chi bar 'gyur la/ zla ba'i rlung de bzhin du rgyu ba na'ang nad la sogs pa'i 'tshe ba 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ skyes khyim du skyes skar la zla ba son cing nyi ma bdun zur na yod pa de'i tshe rgyas pa'i dus zhes bya ba 'tsho 'chi brtag pa'i khyad par gyi dus te/ rgyas pa'i dus su nyi ma'i rlung nyin phyed kyi bar du rgyu na lo bcu bzhi nas 'chi zhing zhag gcig rgyu na lo bcu gnyis su 'chi ba nas/ zhag bco lngar rgyu na lo gcig zhag nyer lngar rgyu na zla gsum/ zla gcig rgyu na zhag gsum/ nyi ma so gsum rgyu na de nyid kyi nyin mor 'chi ba sogs shes par bya zhing nang gi ltas ni 'tsho 'chi rtogs pa la shin tu gal che ste/ slob dpon gyis/ ji srid nang gi mtshan nyid ni// yang dag nges par ma gyur na// phyi yi mtshan nyid kho nas ni// 'chi ltas legs par nges ma yin// gnyis ka nges par gsal ba ni// 'chi ba nyid du nges par 'gyur// phyi rol blo ni phyin ci log /nad la sogs pas kyang bskyed do// zhes rgyu mtshan dang bcas te gsungs so// gzhan yang snga 'gyur gyi rgyud las/

bzhin 'gyur spyod lam rnams ni 'chal pa dang*// slob dpon 'tsho byed dus las yol ba dang*// kha zas rnams kyang yi gar mi 'ong ba// 'di dag rnams ni nyams pa'i rtags yin no// zhes sogs nges pa dang ma nges pa dang*/ nye ba dang ring ba'i 'chi ltas kyi bye brag ni bsam gyis mi khyab pas gzhan las shes par bya ba kho na'o// gsum pa dus gang du brtag na/ zhi ba lhas/ nyin mtshan sdod pa yod med par// tshe 'di rtag tu god 'gyur zhing*// bsnon pa gud nas yongs med na// bdag lta 'chi bar cis mi 'gyur// zhes nges par 'chi zhing myur du 'chi ba'i nges pa can yin pas phyi bshol mi bya bar chos bsgrub pa dang 'chi ba bslu ba'i thabs la da lta nas brtson dgos kyi/ rtsa rlung gi nus pa bsdus zin pa dang*/ nad kyis lus zungs bcom pa dang*/ 'byung gdon gyis gnad la thebs zin nas 'chi ba bslur med de/ dper na/ 'og khang la me shor skabs thabs kyis gsod na bcos su yod kyi/ steng khang la shor nas mi gsod cing 'chos su med pa dang 'dra'o// de la dgongs te slob dpon gyis/ 'chi ba'i mtshan nyid ring mo nas// shes bya 'os pas bcos par bya// spyi bor thog ni babs pa'i tshe// rab tu mkhas kyang ci byar yod// ces gsungs so// bzhi pa ni/ zla zer las/ ji ltar 'bras bu'i me tog dang*// me yi du ba char gyi sprin// phyis 'byung mtshan ma yin pa ltar// de bzhin 'chi ltas las nges 'chi// 'chi ltas med na mi 'chi la// 'chi ltas snang na 'tsho mi 'gyur// zhes 'byung ste 'jig rten na 'bras bu dang me dang char pa rnams 'byung ba'i snga ltas me tog du ba sprin rnams kyi mtshan ma 'byung ba bzhin du rgyu sngar byung na 'bras bu phyis 'byung ba la the tshom ma mchis so// lnga pa ni/ slob dpon gyis/ 'chi ltas rnams ni mtha' yas phyir// gcig car 'byung bar mi 'dod cing*// thams cad rim pas kyang ma yin// 'on kyang gcig sogs grangs kyis so// zhes gsungs pa ltar skyes bu gcig gi 'tsho ba zad pa la 'chi ltas grangs med pa de dag rim dang gcig car du 'byung ba ma yin cing*/

nges pa'i 'chi ltas ni gcig gam gnyis sogs 'byung la des kyang nges par 'chi zhing ma nges pa'i 'chi ltas mang du byung yang 'chi ba bslu ba'i thabs kyis bzlog par 'gyur ba dang*/ yang kha cig rmi lam dang rnam 'gyur la sogs pa'i 'chi ltas ma byung yang 'chi bar 'gyur ba ni/ tshe gzugs sam/ rlung 'them pa sogs nges par 'chi ltas shar rung rang gis ma nges pa dang*/ rmi lam la sogs pa'i ltas byung rung mi 'chi ba ni lhas chos la bskul ba dang*/ chos spyod pa la 'byung po la sogs pas gnod pa rtsom pa'i ltas su rigs par bya'o// drug pa ni/ slob dpon gyis/ 'chi ba ring nas nges byed cing*// ji ltar nus pas gtong ba dang*// gso ba la yang 'jug pa ni// rab tu grub pa chen por 'gyur// ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'chi ba'i ltas ma shes pas nam 'chi'i dus tshod mi shes/ de ma shes pas chos dang 'tsho thabs la brtson 'grus rtsom pa mi byed/ de ma brtsams pas tshe zad pa ma tshor bar 'chi ba'i dus thems te bslur med pas ring mo nas 'tsho 'chi brtags te 'tsho thabs la 'bad pas ring 'tsho'i 'bras bu tshegs med par 'grub par 'gyur ro// bdun pa 'tsho thabs kyi cho ga la mtha' yas kyang bsdu na gnyis te phyi dang nang ngo*// dang po la gsum/ nor bu dang*/ sman dang*/ sgo gsum gyi bya ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ mchog dang phal pa'o// dang po ni/ rje rang byung zhabs kyis/ rgyal ba'i ring bsrel nor bu'i mchog /dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bar byed// nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems// de bzhin rnal 'byor ldan pa'i gdung*// mchod cing lus la bcangs pa yis// gdon kun phyogs su nye mi nus// zhes pa ltar de dag ni 'chang ba lta ci smos/ mthong thos dran reg tsam gyis sdig sgrib zhi zhing 'dod pa'i dngos grub 'byung ba sogs phan yon mtha' yas shing nor bu mchog rnams kyang rgyal ba'i gdung 'ba' zhig las grub pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/

rtog pa las/ rin chen mtshan nyid bstan bcos su// bshad pas rab brtags rdo rje 'chang*// tshe yi nor bu 'chang ba'ang rung*// de bzhin sna tshogs nor bu 'chang*// ind+ra nī la rin chen sogs// nor bu chen po gzhan dag kyang*// bcangs pas 'chi ba thams cad ni// bslu bar 'gyur ba the tshom med// gang phyir nor bu'i mthu 'dir ni// som nyi bya bar rigs min te// nor bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// mthu dang ldan par thams cad 'dod// ces pa ltar/ rdo rje rin po che

dri med 'od las/ bram ze dang*/ rgyal rigs dang*/ rje'u rigs dang*/ dmangs rigs las skyes pa'i rdo rje rin po che zhes gsungs pa/ rigs bzhi dang*/ inda nī la sogs padma rā ga zla ba chu shel/ karke ta/ marke ta ste/ mchog gi rin po che lnga/ gser sogs dngul/ zangs/ lcags rnon po/ khab len te/ 'bring po lnga/ shel sogs dzī badzā ti/ ḍau hi ta/ mching bu/ nor bu ljang gu ste/ tha ma lnga/ rgyal po 'khyil pa/ chu'i nor bu/ sbrul dang gla ba'i nor bu/ dkar khra men/ gzi mig dgu/ ce spyang rwa/ ku sha bhandha la sogs pa'i rin po che bcangs pas nad gdon rims dug sogs srung zhing zhi ba dang*/ 'ga' zhig cho ga dang sbyar na tshe ring por 'tsho ba'i bcud len du 'gyur ba sogs nor bu sna re'i phan yon kyang bsam gyis mi khyab bo// gnyis pa la gnyis/ sman dang bcud len no// dang po ni/ sman gyi nor bu a ru ra rnam par rgyal ba dang*/ shu dag gla rtsi/ sle tres/ yungs kar la sogs pa rang bzhin gyis grub pa dang*/ rin chen ril bu dang mang sbyor chen mo la sogs pa sbyar ba'i sman rnams bcangs pa'am zos pa'i phan yon kyang mngon tu 'byung ste/ rtog pa las/ grub pa'i sman ni gzhan rnams kyang*// nges par brten par gyur pa yis// tshe 'phel ba dang rga ba'i nad// zad pas 'chi ba mi mthong ngo*// zhes so// gnyis pa ni bcud len gyi bstan bcos rnams nas 'byung ba bzhin sbyor tshul bsten lugs bsam gyis mi khyab la/ gtso bo ni/ bdud rtsi lnga po rab sbyar ba// man ngag ji bzhin bsten pa yis// 'chi ba bslu bar 'gyur ba ni// kha sbyor la sogs rgyud las gsungs// zhes dang*/ dngul dang gser sogs kyis bcings pa'i// dngul chu cho ga bzhin zos na// grub pa'i bcud len rang bzhin phyir// 'chi ba bslu bar 'gyur ba yin// zhes pa la sogs pa gzhung rnams su rgya cher 'byung ba nyid bsten par bya ste rgas pa skra dkar gnyer ma dang bral zhing tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa sogs bcud len gyi mthu ni bsam gyis mi khyab bo// gsum pa la bzhi ste/

lus kyi bya ba lha khang mchod rten sku gzugs gsar du bzhengs pa 'dul ba lung rnams 'byed las/ kun dga' ra ba 1gtsug lag khang*/2 /mal stan 3'tsho ba nar ma dang*/4 /glo bur 5nad par 6nad g.yog dang*// yul ngan tshe na sbyin pa 7ni// rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bdun// ces/ sogs rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bdun dang*/ zhig pa 'chos pa/ sātstsha 'debs pa/ lam 'phrang 'chos pa/ rten gsum la mchod pa'i bye brag 'bul ba/ dge bdun la chos ston gsol ba/ pha ma bla ma ye shes rgan pa bsnyen bkur ba/ mchod rten la phyag dang bskor ba byed pa la sogs pa dang*/ ngag gi bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ dkon mchog ta la/ phal po che la sogs pa theg pa chen po'i mdo sde zab cing rgya che ba rnams dang*/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde zab mo rnams dang srung ba lnga dang gza' yum la sogs pa'i gzungs/ khyad par tshe dpag med dang gtsug tor rnam rgyal gtsug tor dri med la sogs pa'i gzungs rang gis kha ton tu bgyid pa'am/ dge slong tshul dang ldan pa la bkur sti dang bcas te 'don 'jug pa dang*/ yid kyi bya ba rtog pa las// 'bad pas 'chi ba bslu ba ni// dad pa nyid kyis bya bar nus// de bas dad pa brtan par bya// gzhan tu ngal ba don med 'gyur// zhes sogs 'byung ba ltar dkon mchog la dad pa brtan po dang*/ las 'bras la yid ches/ bsgrub bya'i lha la nges shes/ khyad par byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems la nan tan tu bslab cing 'tsho ba'i cho ga la spro ba chen po dang ldan par bya'o// gsum ka'i bya bar bden pa dang dka' thub/ sbyin dang bzod pa/ dkyil 'khor bri ba/ sbyin sreg phyag rgya/ gtor ma/ tshogs 'khor la sogs pa bya ba dang*/ rtog pa las/ bya nya ri dwags rkun ma dang*// sbrul sogs gsad bya'i phyogs gyur rnams// srog bskyabs pa yis 'phral du ni// tshe thung ba yang tshe ring 'gyur// ces dang*/

btson ra nad dang gdung ba dang*// 'tshe sogs 'jigs pa ji tsam yang*// bskyabs byas na ni nges pa ru// tshe ring 'chi ba slu byed yin// zhes pa ltar 'bras bu'i rgyu mthun pa la nan tan tu 'bad pa dang*/ khyad par dben par ras bris bkram pa'i mdun tu mchod pa dang gtsang sbra bcas te/ lha la sems rtse gcig pas spyan ras gzigs yi ge phyed bzhi pa 'bru 'bum bzla ba dang*/ sgrol ma'i snying po bcu bdun ma dang*/ so 'brang ma'i snying po grangs su bzlas pa'i mthar dūrba'i sbyin sreg bcu cha bya ba dang*/ spyan ma'i rig pa bkru ba'i cho ga dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa cho ga ltar bzla ba dang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug 'chi ba las rgyal gyi gsang sngags 'bru 'bum bzlas mthar me tog dkar po'i sbyin sreg byed pa la sogs pas sdig pa dang nad zhi ba dang*/ 'chi ba bslus nas nges par tshe ring por 'gyur te sngags kyi mthu ni bsam gyis mi khyab pas so// gnyis pa nang ltar na gnyis gzhan gyis 'tsho ba'i cho ga byed pa dang*/ rang gis byed pa'o// dang po ni/ tshe nyams pa la sogs pa'i ltas mthong yang rang nyid kyis gso ba'i thabs mi shes pa'i skye bo phal pa'am/ shes kyang nyams su len mi nus pa dag gis mkhyen brtse nus pa dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gzhan la brten te ring 'tsho'i cho ga bsgrub dgos te/ de'i mtshan nyid kyang snga 'gyur gyi rgyud las/ ting 'dzin phra mo las su rung ba dang*// rgyud kyi don la mkhas shing dbang thob pa// mthu byin che zhing dam can nye ba gsum// 'di gsum gang gis bkug kyang khug par 'gyur// ces gsungs pa ltar te gso byed kyi tshul ni lhag pa'i lha khyad par can gyi rnal 'byor la brten nas rang don tu sgrub pa'i tshul ltar la ting nge 'dzin gyi kha sgyur ci rigs su bya ba yin no// gnyis pa la gnyis/ bskyed rim gyis tshe sring ba dang*/

rdzogs rim la brten nas sring ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'o// dang po ni/ sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud phyi ma las/ bgegs 'joms bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ni// dang por 'bum phrag bzlas byas nas// mchod rten la sogs byed pa dang*// mchod dang skor ba la sogs bya// zhes 'byung ste/ char 'bebs pa la rlung mnan pa'am/ lo tog bskrun pa la gnod pa srung ba'i bya ba gtsor 'don dgos pa ltar/ 'dod pa'i don bsgrub pa la thog mar bar chad nges par zhi bar ma byas na 'bad pa don dang mi ldan pas/ spyi 'gror bgegs mthar byed kyi rtsa sngags sam snying po 'bum dang sbyin sreg khri bya ba'am/ dmigs bsal rang rigs kyi las kyi lha bdud bgegs 'dul ba la ched du bsngags pa'i khro bo chen po gang yang rung ba'i sgom bzlas sbyin sreg dang bcas pas bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi bar bya ste tshong don gnyer tu 'gro ba la skyel ma'am grogs stobs chen dang 'grogs pa bzhin tshe sgrub spyi la 'di kho na gal che bas/ gsar rnying gi man ngag 'gar tshe rta zung 'brel dang tshe phur sbrags ma sogs 'byung ba'ang don 'di la dgongs pa'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ spyir rang gi lhag pa'i lha gang yin pa'i rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu gnas pa dang*/ khyad par 'chi med tshe dbang stsol ba la ched du thugs bskyed cing smon lam yongs su grub pa bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad/ tshe dpag med/ 'jig rten dbang phyug yid bzhin 'khor lo la sogs pa gtso bo rkyang pa'i bskyed rim nan tan tu bslab cing bzlas pa bya ba dang*/ phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ gtsug tor dri med sogs dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i bskyed bzlas bya ba dang*/ sdom pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa keng rus tā rā'i gdams ngag gam/ zla ba ba 'jo'i bsam gtan sogs gang yang rung ba'i bsam gtan la zla ba drug la sogs par rtse gcig tu gnas pas nges par 'chi ba las rgyal bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa la gnyis/

mtshan bcas kyi rdzogs rim dang*/ mtshan med kyi rdzogs rim la brten te tshe sring ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ zhar byung ngo*// dang po la gnyis/ rdor bzlas dang*/ bum pa can no// dang po ni/ spyir rim lnga las/ brjod dang dmigs par bcas pa dang*// brda gyur dang ni don dam mo// zhes rdor bzlas kyi dbye ba bzhir gsungs pa gang yang rung ba 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pas tshe nyams pa'ang lo lngar 'tsho ba sdom 'byung las gsungs/ khyad par bdud rtsi sdud pa'am rtsol ba 'gog pa zhes tshe sring ba la mchog tu bsngags pa'i man ngag gi rdor bzlas ni/ rtog pa las/ rlung ni 'jug pa bsngags pa yin// bdud rtsi 'tsho bar byed pa'i thabs// de phyir 'chi bas mi tshugs so// rim gyis 'bum sogs grangs kyis ni// rtse gcig sems kyis cho ga bzhin// rlung ni 'jug pa bgrang ba ni// sgra med pa yi bzlas par bshad// sgra med bzlas pa 'bum phrag gi /cho ga yongs su rdzogs pa yis// mi ni tshe nyams gyur pa yang*// lo lnga'i bar du 'tsho bar nges// nyis 'bum la sogs bzlas pa nyid// tshe 'phel bar ni bsgre bar bya// zhes dang*/ nangs par langs nas stong phrag gcig /rtag tu legs par bgrangs na ni// nad kun las ni rnam grol zhing*// nyi zla gnas kyi bar du 'tsho// zhes so// gnyis pa bum pa can che 'bring chung gsum las chen po grub pas tshe sring bar 'gyur te/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/ nyin mtshan du ni dbu mar srog /zhugs pas nad rnams 'phrog par byed// tshes kyi nyin zhag srog bcings na// 'dis ni mkha' spyod nyid ster byed// zla gcig srog bsad snying gar gnas// rnal 'byor pa rnams 'chi med 'gyur// zhes bum pa can zhag gcig 'chings nus pas nad las rgyal ba dang*/ zla phyed kyi mkha' spyod 'grub pa dang*/ zla gcig gis 'chi med 'grub par bshad do// gnyis pa zhar byung ni/ skra dkar la sogs pa'i 'jig cing 'jigs pa las srung ba sogs phan stobs chen po dang ldan pa'i lce rtse rkan sbyar gyi bzlas pa/

'phral du 'chi ltas zlog cing yun du 'chi med 'grub pa'i nam mkha' ba 'jo'i bsam gtan/ 'chi ltas kyi 'phel ba zlog pa yon po srong ba la sogs pa gdams ngag so so las 'ongs pa'i gnad dang sbyar te rtse gcig gam zhar byung du bsgoms pas kyang tshe sring ba'i nus pa chen po dang ldan pas 'di dag ni gzhan kun gyi yan lag tu sbyar ba'ang bya'o// gnyis pa mtshan med kyi rdzogs rim la rnam grangs dang*/ don dam gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mkhas pas dngos po mi sgom zhing*// dngos po med pa'ang bsam mi bya// dngos dang dngos med las rnam grol// de spangs pa ni bsgom par bya// zhes pa'i tshul la dpyad sgom pas rgyas 'debs dang*/ 'jog sgom pas mos dpyod kyi tshul gyis nyams su len pa dang*/ gnyis pa yul rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid dang*/ yul can 'gyur med kyi bde ba chen po ro mnyam mngon sum lam du byed de ting nge 'dzin gyi sku bsgrub pa ste/ de dag gis ni srid pa'i 'chi ba sogs chu bo bzhi gtan du gcod pa'i phyir/ ngag gi dbang phyug gis/ rnam kun 'chi ba bslu ba ni// grol ba nyid la rags pa yin// ma grol ba rnams thams cad la// ji tsam dus las bsring ba'o// zhes dang*/ de bzhin nyid kyis 'chi dang bdud// dgra rnams gzhan las rgyal bar 'gyur// nyes pa ma lus rab tu zhi// yon tan ma lus 'byung ba dang*// skyes bu de nyid kyis rgyal zhing*// mngon par 'dod pa rnams kyang 'grub// de bzhin nyid ni stong nyid bshad// rnam pa kun mchog bdag nyid can// de nyid rtag tu goms byas na// 'chi ba bslu bar 'gyur ba yin// ces gsungs so// de dag kyang mdor na tshe zad pa la tshe chog 'chi bslu/ rlung gi sbyor ba sogs dang*/ las zad pa la srog bslu/ nye'u 'don/ dka' thub la sogs pa dang*/ bsod nams zad pa la mchod pa dang sbyin gtong la sogs pas gso zhing dad pa brtson 'grus bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len ni thams cad du gal che'o// de'i phyir slob dpon gyis/

bsod nams kyis ni 'dod pa 'grub// de bas bsod nams 'bad pas bya// dad pas thams cad yang dag 'grub// de bas dad pa rnam par spel// brtson 'grus kyis ni brtsam pa 'grub// de bas brtson 'grus sngon 'gro bya// bsam gtan gyis ni 'dod 'bras brtan// de phyir bsam gtan sems gcig bya// 'du 'dzi spangs pas nyams len 'gyur// de phyir 'du 'dzi rnam par spang*// yang dag shes ldan thams cad 'grub// de bas ye shes kun ldan bya// zhes gsungs so// brgyad pa la snga 'gyur dang phyi 'gyur gnyis/ dang po snga 'gyur bka' ma'i phyogs su bdud rtsi 'khyil pa 'chi med tshe'i rgyud sogs rang rkang tshugs pa dang*/ 'dus mdo'i rtsa rgyud le'u bcu gsum pa nas bshad pa'i tshe dkyil dang*/ rdzogs chen gyi rgyud rnams nas 'chi bslu gsal rgyas su gsungs pas mtshon zhar byung gi rim pa ji snyed mchis pa la brten/ 'dus mdo'i yan lag gi tshe dkyil dang*/ sgyu 'phrul yan lag sangs rgyas gsang ba'i man ngag tshe dpag med lung lugs su grags pa gnyis la zur pa dang rong zom rog smin gling sku mched sogs kyi yig cha dang dbang lung rgyun ma chad par bzhugs shing*/ cho ga'i chings lung bdun gyis 'ching bar mdzad de/ tshe bca' tshe yi dkyil 'khor dang*// tshe yi rang bzhin 'gugs pa dang*// tshe bcing tshe yi brlan thabs dang*// tshe yi dbang bskur bstim pa'o// zhes pa ltar ro// gter ma'i phyogs la/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa padma ka ra nyid nges pa'i don tu rgyal ba thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje nyid du grub kyang gdul bya gzhan snang du tshe lam gyi phyag rgya padma can la brten te mā ra ti kar tshe dbang rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i tshul bstan/ tshe rgyud bya ba brgya phrag lha mo tsandha līs phul zhing tshe dpag med kyis gnang ba bstsal ba la brten tshe'i rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i thabs dpag tu med par mdzad de 'phags bod la sogs par rgya cher spel zhing*/

ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya la dgongs nas phyogs bzhi dbus lnga'i gter du btsas pa rnams/ sku gsum rigs 'dus snga phyi gsum nyang dang sangs gling byang bdag gsum gyis phyung zhing*/ rad gling dang pad gling gis rdo rje phreng ba phyung bas mtshon gter ston re res kyang tshe sgrub kyi gdams pa 'dra min mang du bton pa'i rgyud dang gdams pa'i rnam grangs brjod par mi langs kyang*/ ngo bo'i sgo nas bsdu na/ gtso sgrub bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med dang*/ thugs rje chen po yab yum/ bla ma longs sku dang sprul sku'i sgrub thabs rnams su ci rigs par 'du zhing*/ zhar byung rtsa gsum so so'i las mtha' rgyas ni bsam gyis mi khyab bo// de dag re re la'ang bdag mdun bum pa sgrub pa/ dbang bskur/ tshe rdzas/ 'khor lo/ za yig bcud len/ thabs lam/ nam mkha' zas za sogs la brten nas tshe sring ba'i thabs sna re res kyang dgos pa 'grub pa'i gdams ngag gi dbye bsdu dang*/ bder 'dus las/ tshe lung lngar bshad pas mtshon cho ga'i chings kyi bye brag ni smos kyis mi langs so// dag snang gi phyogs la/ o rgyan chen pos dngos su bstsal ba ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po'i tshe sgrub mda' 'phel mar grags pa ngo mtshar mngon sum skyed pa dang*/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i 'chi med dpal ster zhes byin rlabs tshan kha mchog tu che ba dang*/ 'bri gung chos kyi grags pa'i sgra mi snyan gyi tshe sgrub dbang gzhung las kha tshar bcas pa dang*/ snang gsal ba bkra shis rgya mtsho'i hrīḥgacig ma zhes zab cing rgya che ba dang*/ khrag 'thung nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi dag snang rig 'dzin srog sgrub las 'byung ba'i tshe sgrub bskyed rdzogs shin tu zab pa sogs yongs su grags pa dang ma grags pa shin tu mang ste so so'ang dbang bskur bsnyen sgrub las kha tshar dang bcas pa'o// rlung gi rnal 'byor gtso bor bstan cing bcud len gyi sgo nas rdo rje'i tshe sgrub pa la mchog tu zab cing yongs su grags pa ni slob dpon chen po'i sgyu 'phrul gyi bkod pa grub chen dzā hā bhir gyi gdams pa bhrūm̐ rlung rigs gsum ste/

bka' bab dang po dzo ki badzra nā thas chos rgyal rin chen phun tshogs la bstsal ba dang*/ thar pa ma ṇi ka nā thas 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la gnang ba dang*/ phyi ma grub chen nyi zla klong gsal la dag pa'i snang bar dzā bhīr nyid kyis dngos su gnang ba ste snga ma gnyis la lung dang khrid kyi rgyun dang*/ phyi ma la dbang lung smin khrid byin rlabs nyams myong grub pa'i rtags mtshan ma chad par bzhugs so// gnyis pa phyi 'gyur gsar ma'i phyogs su tshe'i mdo rgyud rang rkang tshugs pa ni/ bya rgyud padma'i rigs kyi gtso bo tshe dpag med pa'i mdo gzungs dang*/ 'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs gnyis/ gshegs rigs kyi yum gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma la/ bde ba can dang*/ ngan 'gro yongs sbyong*/ 'chi bdag dbyug 'dzin bcas gzungs sde gsum du bzhugs la/ gtsug tor dri med kyang tshe spel ba gtso bor gsungs shing*/ rgyud sde bzhi kar zhar las 'ongs pa ni mtha' yas so// de dag la brten pa'i cho ga dang gdams ngag gi skor ni/ rnal 'byor 'phros rgyud ngan song sbyong ba'i brtag pa nas gsungs pa slob dpon kun dga' snying po'i bka' srol jo bo rje las brgyud pa phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa lha bcu gsum pa dang*/ gsung dkyil tshe dpag med lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis/ grub pa'i slob dpon dze ta ris bkral ba mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i gzungs la brten pa'i tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ rnga sgra'i gzungs la brten pa'i lha bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor gnyis/ 'gro ba'i me long gis bya btus su bshad pa gtsug tor rnam rgyal lha so gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ mi tra'i rdor phreng du'ang lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs shing*/ bde ba can gyi gtsug tor rnam rgyal gzungs la brten pa rnam rgyal lha dgu pa'i lugs te snga ma rnams dbang dang phyi ma rjes gnang gi rgyun la brten sgrub mchod stong mchod dbang bsnyen sgrub 'chi bslu sogs kyis 'gro ba mtha' yas pa dus min 'chi las skyob cing gnas skabs mthar thug gi dngos grub stsol ba grub mtha' yongs la grags so// gtsug tor dri med lha drug gi rig pa gtad pa'i rgyun dkyil 'khor dang srog shing 'jug pa sātstsha gdab pa'i cho ga

'chi bslu'i yig cha phyag len gyis brgyan pa'i byin rlabs can zhwa lu dang ngor lugs la bzhugs shing dar srol kyang cher byung ngo*// bde mchog rtsa rgyud 'bum pa sogs las bstan pa'i ma rgyud padma gar dbang ngam dpal he ru ka'i rigs tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs su grags pa ni ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mos rje btsun 'ja' tshon gyi sku can ras chung rdo rje grags pa la dngos su stsal ba ste/ 'di la phyi sgrub lha tshogs stong dang lnga brgya/ nang sgrub nyis brgya nyer lnga/ gsang sgrub lha bcu gsum ma ste dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba dang*/ gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs yang gsang lha gcig bum gcig tshe dpag sprul sku'i sgrub thabs/ dkar po phyag bzhi pa sogs mtha' yas pa zhig yod par grags shing*/ 'brug lugs zhi ba lha mang dang khro bo lha mang gi dbang lung rgyun dang*/ gtso rkyang gsum gyi rjes gnang sogs dang*/ khyad par lha gcig bum gcig ni grub mtha' yongs la grags shing shin tu khyab che bas ras chung pa'i gdams ngag sham bu can bco brgyad kyi nang gses tshe dpag med 'gro don gyi sham bu can tu bzhed cing*/ 'di la 'ba' ra ba'i snyan brgyud bskyed bzlas kyi rim pa la brten nas tshe bcud bsdu ba/ rtsa rlung thig le la brten pa'i rdzogs rim ste man ngag khyad par can gyi tshe khrid mtha' rgyas bcud len gyi las tshogs dang bcas pa grub pa'i mtshan rtags ma chad par bzhugs so// gzhan yang ngan song sbyong rgyud la brten pa a bhā ya'i gdams ngag ba ri lugs kyi tshe dpag med sprul sku dang*/ gzungs las gsungs pa'i tshe dpag med dkar po grub chen mi tra dzo ki'i bzhed srol chag lo nas brgyud pa tshar lugs dkar po lha gsum du 'dren pa dang*/ bcangs pa tsam gyis skye ba dran pa bslab btus nas bshad pa'i lus srung ba'i rig sngags dang tshul gcig pa lha'i dge bsnyen gyis byang gling nas blangs te dgra bcom pa blo gros dpal la gtad pa sgra mi snyan gyi tshe'i rang gzungs su grags pa la rang lus lcags kyi rdo rjer bsgom zhing gzung sngags bzla ba gtad lung gi brgyud pa can dang*/

shāka thub sgom bzlas yod pa'i sgom lung phog pa dang*/ tshe dpag med lhung bzed bsnams pa'i mngon rtogs dang 'brel ba tshe dbang sgrub thabs bcas paṇa chen nags rin nas brgyud pa ste lugs gsum dang*/ rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha drug gi ya gyal thub pa me ru shi ṣa dang*/ shākya rakṣi ta'i man ngag rnam rgyal ma phyag gnyis la sogs pa gtso rkyang gi rigs ni mang du 'byung ngo*// bod snga ma rnams sgrol ma ral pa gyen brdzes kyi rgyud sogs la brten pa'i bya rgyud padma'i rigs kyi yum du bzhed cing*/ thams cad mkhyen pa sgrol ba'i mgon pos sgrol ma bla med kyi shing rta gsar du drangs pa nas khungs chod de mngon 'byung gi rgyud la brten par bzhed pa/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa'i 'chi bdag slu ba'i rtog pa las phyung ba sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo la bod du bka' bab bzhi'am drug tu bzhed pa'i dang po jo bo lugs la sgrub thabs las tshogs tshe khrid dang bcas pa byin rlabs dang grub pa'i mtshan ma ma chad pa khyad 'phags su bzhugs/ gnyis pa ba ri lugs la sgrol dkar 'od zer drug sbrags su grags pa'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa dang*/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i tshe khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun ltar khrid rgyun smin rgyas/ las tshogs ches mang ba dang bcas pa/ gsum pa gnyan lugs dang*/ bzhi pa paṇa chen nags rin lugs bcas yongs su grags shing*/ ngag dbang grags pas mar pa dang des rngog chos sku rdo rje la gnang ba'i rngog lugs te lnga po de 'chi bslu'i rgya gzhung kho na la brten par grags/ bka' bab drug pa sgar lugs ni rje rol pa'i rdo rje la rje btsun sgrol mas dngos su bstsal ba'i nye brgyud de bdag bskyed sgrol dkar lha dgu'i sgom bzlas dang*/ mdun bskyed tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs dang mtshungs pa'i bzlas sgom can no// gzhan yang a bhā ya'i lugs lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan nas brgyud pa dang*/

rdo rje gdan pa niṣkā laṃ ka nas dpyal chos kyi bzang po la brgyud pa dang*/ kha che paṇa chen lugs sgrol dkar lha dgu ma dang*/ slob dpon yid bzhin nor bu sbyin pa'i lugs 'chi med 'phags ma sgrol ma bcas thams cad kyang rjes gnang sngon du 'gro ba'i bskyed rim yan lag bzhi ldan bzlas pa spro bsdu dang bcas pas tshe sring ba dang*/ khyad par jo bo lugs la bskyed bzlas gnyis la nang gses bzhi/ mtshan bcas kyi rdzogs rim gnyis/ mtshan med gcig bcas kyis tshe bsring ba dang*/ ba ri lugs la bskyed rim gyi khyad par dmigs gnad 'khor lo gsal gdab/ rigs bdag 'pho ba/ srung 'khor/ tshe bcud bsdu ba/ sngags bzlas lnga'i sgo nas tshe bsring ba yin no// sgrol dkar gyi las tshogs mtha' dag ni mang mkhar ba blo gros bzang pos phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa sgrol dkar chen mor grags pa'i be'u bum du gsal zhing khungs dang ldan pa'o// rgyud gdan bzhi nas sgrol dkar gyi 'khor lo gsungs pa dang*/ tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs kyis mtshon bla med nas kyang tshe sgrub pa'i lha sngags dngos dang brgyud nas ji snyed cig bstan la/ zur bka' bzhugs pa ni/ bde mchog bshad rgyud a bhi dha na las bstan pa 'chi med rdo rje lha mo zhes bya ba dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gser chos bcu gsum gyi nang tshan shin tu zab pa ste/ rgyud de nyid las/ 'di ni khri tsam bzlas byas na// 'chi ba nges par 'tsho bar 'gyur// dus min 'chi ba zhi 'gyur zhing*// 'chi ba las ni nges par slong*// zhes pa ltar phan yon mchog dang ldan pa dang*/ rtsa rgyud las/ dus min 'chi ba slu ba la// yan lag kha ṭwāṃ dag dang sbyar// thod pa'i mchod yon snod du ni// zhal du mtshon cha nges par sbyar// zhes pa'i bstan don la kha ṭwāṃ ga dang thod sbyor gyi dmigs pa tsam dang*/ dpal ldan 'brug pa'i man ngag sogs kyang 'byung mod kyi gtso bor kha che paṇa chen gyi khyad 'phags lha bzhi'i ya gyal bde mchog dkar po'i tshe sgrub la tshar lugs kyi bskyed rdzogs khrid dang bcas pa'ang 'byung la tshe sgrub pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor gyi gtso bo ni de tsam ste zhar las 'ongs pa ni mang ngo*// nad zhi mdzad sman gyi bla dang sangs rgyas spyan ma/

rmi lam ngan pa zlog pa spyan ras gzigs yi ge phyed dang bzhi pa/ sa 'og gdon 'joms seng ge sgra dang ye shes khyung khra/ 'jigs pa bcu drug las skyob pa sgrol ma ljang gu dang sna tshogs yum/ grib gdon gnyen po rnam 'joms dang sme ba brtsegs pa/ byad kha zlog byed gdugs dkar mo dang seng gdong ma la sogs pa rnams kyang ring du 'tsho ba'i cho ga'i yan lag tu 'gyur ro// sngags gsar rnying las bcud len gyi gzhung gdams ngag mtha' yas pa gsungs mod/ dus kyi dbang gis ji bzhin pa sgrub pa dkon zhing 'grub dka' yang*/ bka' ma lo chen bai ro'i lugs dang*/ byang gter sogs kyi bka' srol/ gsar ma'i gdams ngag ci rigs las phyag rgyun ma chad tsam bzhugs shing nus pa thon pa'ang mtha' ma 'gag tsam snang la grub chen o rgyan pa'i lugs kyi dngul chu btso bkru chen mo/ rin chen tsha grang sbyor ba'i phyag len shin tu khungs btsun zur mkhar khu dbon dang kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyin byed las brgyud de rkang gnyis lus srog 'tsho ba'i bcud len khyad 'phags su sbyor ba'i rgyun kyang bzhugs bzhin pa'o// dgu pa la gnyis/ cho ga de rnams ring 'tsho'i bya ba dang ji ltar 'brel ba dang dogs gnas la dpyad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ spyi dang khyad par ro// dang po ni/ spyir lhag pa'i lha rnams la thugs rje dang nus pa tshad med pa mnga' zhing*/ sgos dmigs bsal du smos pa de rnams thugs bskyed dang smon lam gyi khyad par las 'gro ba gang zhig tshe yis phongs pa la tshe stsol zhing*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba las skyob pa'i phrin las khyad par can mnga' bas sgom zhing bzlas pa lta ci smos/ gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis kyang gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster ba ste/ ngag dbang grags pas/ rang gi 'dod lha'i rnal 'byor gyis// nga rgyal brtan par gyur pa las// yin bzhin nor ltar ma lus pa'i// 'dod pa'i don ni rab sgrub byed// ces so// gnyis pa ni/

dper na phyi rol gyi khang pa la skyon med na nang gi ka ba brtan cing*/ ka ba brtan pas khang pa mi 'jig pa gcig la gcig ltos pa bzhin/ lus srog phan tshun tu ltos pas srog gnas pa'ang lus la rags las shing*/ lus kyi 'tsho ba srog la ltos pa ste/ lus ni rgyud dang gso dpyad sogs las zhib par 'byung ba bzhin dang po 'byung ba bzhi'i dwangs ma 'dus pa las skyes/ bar du 'byung ba bzhi gcig grogs gcig gis byas te gnas/ tha mar gcig gshed gcig gis byas te srog 'dor ba phyi snod kyi chags 'jig dang mtshungs shing*/ 'byung bzhi 'khrugs pa'i rgyu dug gsum dang rkyen zas spyod ma snyoms pas byed cing*/ de las dwangs ma zad cing snyigs ma 'phel ba'i rtags lus la shar ba ste/ sa'i dwangs ma nyams pas sha skem/ gnyer ma 'du/ chu nyams pas khrag skem/ mdangs nyams/ lus gyong*/ me nyams pas drod shor/ sha sngo/ rlung nyams pas stobs med/ lus rgud/ nam mkha'i dwangs ma nyams pas brjed ngas che/ rig pa 'thibs/ de las dbang po rnams kyang 'grib ste/ lus dang dbang po srog rnams ni// 'gag pa 'chi ba'i mtshan nyid do// zhes pa de 'byung ba yin la/ rnam rtog gzhan tu mi g.yo bas lha bsgom pa dang*/ ngag dang 'gog pa sogs bzlas pa'i bye brag la rtse gcig tu brtson pas sems kyi bcud ma zag pas lus kyi dwangs ma stobs rgyas te srog mi g.yo ba'i rten 'brel 'grig pa dang*/ phung khams lha la sogs par snang ba dus kyi zhags pas kyang 'ching bar 'os pa ma yin pa dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum shin tu sbyangs pas srog ye shes kyi char ji tsam bkag pa de tsam dus kyi chad pa las ring du bsring bar grub pa dang*/ phyi nang rten 'brel gyi 'gros gcig cing snang ba sems kyi rang gzugs yin pa'i dbang las tshe bcud bsdu bstim gyi 'phro 'dus nang gi 'byung bzhi'i dwangs ma stobs su gyur pa las gong du smos pa'i nyes pa thams cad zad cing de las ldog pa'i yon tan rnams skyed pa'i phyir/

lus nad gnyen po bdag nyid gcig par 'brel// zhes pa ltar cho ga byas pas lus srog 'tsho ba'i 'brel ni de la sogs pa mang mod kyi mdor bsdus so// gnyis pa ni/ dpyod ldan kha cig gis snod dang bcud kyi tshe bcud de dngos su bsdu ba yod na bsdu gzhi la gnod cing*/ med na bsdu yul la mi phan pa'i dogs slong mdzad do// des ni yang na dmigs pa'i 'khrul 'khor thams cad don med du 'gyur bas sngags mi 'grub la/ yang na sngags grub kyang spyod pa phyin ci log tu song bas thar pa dang 'gal ba sogs the tshom du ma slong ba'i phyir gsang sngags la the tshom za ba'i rig par song bas rtog ge ba'i blo gros su zad de/ log pa'i lam la mtha' med phyir// de dag 'dir ni spro bya min// zhes pa ltar ro// de lta na zhi sogs kyi las la'ang dpyad pa 'jug la/ de'ang dpyad na thug med du 'gyur bas sngags kyi las rab 'byams 'gog dgos par 'gyur la/ de 'gog na/ thabs mang dka' ba med pa sogs kyi sgrub byed kyang don med du 'gyur ba dang*/ gzhan yang 'phags pa rnams kyi byin rlabs bsdu ba de'ang dngos su bsdur yod dam med/ med na rang la byin gyis rlob par mi 'gyur la/ yod na 'phags pa la gnod par 'gyur ro// dngos su bsdur med kyang mos pa'i mthu las byin gyis brlab par 'gyur na 'byung bcud sogs la'ang rigs pa mtshungs shing*/ yod kyang 'phags la gnod par mi 'gyur te gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab bo zhe na/ sems can gyi las snang yang bsam gyis mi khyab pas na de bas kyang mtshungs so// gcig shos la phan pas gcig shos la gnod pa kho na'ang ma nges te rgya mtsho las char byung bas lo tog la phan kyang rgya mtsho la mi gnod pa bzhin no// dper na nor bu shin tu sbyangs pa la gsol ba btab pas 'dod pa nyid 'jo yang*/ dngos po de dag gzhan las 'phrog pa'ang med cing nor bu rang gi ngo bo'am gzhan la'ang gnod pa med par rten 'brel gyi nus pas byed po rang nyid la phan btags pa bzhin tu/

sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyi mthu ni bsam gyis mi khyab pas mos pa'i mthu las grub pa sbyin pa ste/ ngag dbang grags pas/ 'jig rten na ni dngos gzhan gang*// sngags kyis mi 'grub de yod min// yang dag dad pas 'bad pa la// sngags rnams yid bzhin nor bur mtshungs// zhes so// des na rtog ge'i rig pas chos nyid dang sngags kyi tshul la gzhal na blo chung mang po ngan 'gro'i g.yang sar 'phen pa las dgos nus gzhan ma mchis pas/ bzod pa dang mngon shes ma thob pa dag gis mos pa brtan pos bsgrub par bya ba kho na yin te/ rgyud las/ chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// don la the tshom med pa yi// mkhas pa la ni dngos grub nye// yang na blun po dad pa brtan// de la sbyor ba'i dngos grub nye// rtog cing dpyod pa'i rtog ge pa// de la dngos grub ring du bskal// zhes ljags byang bar klog bzhin pas so// bcu pa thabs de rnams kyis 'chi ba slu zhing ring du 'tsho ba'i shes byed la gnyis/ spyi dang khyad par ro// dang po la gsum/ gtan tshigs dang dpe dgod/ rgyu mtshan bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ mdo las/ sems can thams cad ni zas kyis gnas pa'o// zhes dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ ngal dang smin dang btung sogs kyis// pho ba'i me ni 'bar gyur la// me ni rab tu 'bar bas zas// yongs su 'ju ba'ang nus pa yin// yongs su zhu bas lus rgyas zhing*// rgyas pas stobs ni rnam par 'phel// stobs las tshe ni 'phel 'gyur zhing*// de 'phel bas ni ring du 'tsho// kun gyis mngon sum grub 'di la// the tshom yod min ji lta ba// de ltar man ngag las bskal sogs// 'tsho ba yang ni the tshom med// ces pa ltar zas dang ldan pas srog 'tsho la mi ldan na 'tsho mi nus pa bzhin 'tsho ba nyid thabs kyi rgyu rkyen la rags las pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon gyis/ snum dang snying po zad sogs las// mar me la sogs 'jig phyogs pa'ang*// slar yang snum sogs rab thob pas// bskal pa'i bar du gnas pa yin// ji ltar de bzhin lus 'di yang*// rgas sogs kyis ni 'chi bzhin par// grub pa'i man ngag legs rnyed na// bskal pa'i mthar mang cis mi gnas// dper na khang pa rnying pa dag

/bcos pa yis ni yun ring gnas// de bzhin rnying pa'i lus ngag kyang*// bcos pas gnas par cis mi 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa ltar tshe sring ba'i thabs la mkhas shing rtsol ba dang ldan na ring du 'tsho ba la dka' ba yod pa ma yin no// gsum pa ni/ mngon pa las srog ni mtha' gcig tu las kyi rnam par smin pa kho na yin pa'i shes byed dgra bcom pa dus mi sbyor bas gang zag khyad par can nam dge 'dun la 'tsho chas phul nas 'dun pa drag pos rab mtha'i bsam gtan la snyoms par zhugs shing de las langs te bdag gi longs spyod kyi rnam par smin pa gang yin pa de tsho'i rnam par smin par gyur cig snyam pa'i dge rtsa nang rnam rig dag gi mthus rnam smin gyi tshe 'jog par bshad pas/ bsod nams gsog pa de yongs su bsngos pas tshe 'phel bar grub ste/ srog bslu ba sogs 'bras bu'i rgyu mthun pa yin pa'i phyir dang*/ de nyid kyang myong bar ma nges pa'i las su mi 'gyur te zhing bsam sbyor ba mthar thug tshang zhing las kyi 'phen pa'i rgyun mthud par byed pa'i phyir chu rka gsos pas yur chu'i rgyun mthud pa bzhin no// des na mdo las/ srog ni rnam par smin pa yin gyi 'das pa'i las kho na'i ni ma yin no zhes pas tshe'i las mthong chos kyi 'bras bu can du bzhed do// gnyis pa ni/ mdo sde rnams su/ las kyi rnam par smin pa ni ma gtogs so// zhes 'byung mod/ rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud las/ mdo sdes ni las kyi rnam par smin pa mi zlog la sngags kyis zlog pas khyad par 'phags so zhes gsungs pa ltar sngags kyi dkyil 'khor zab mo dang*/ phyag rgya dang gsang sngags sogs la brtson pas las kyi rnam smin kyang byang zhing srab par nus na 'phral gyi bar chad tsam sel ba ni lta ci smos shing*/ khyad par sku gsung thugs 'chi med rdo rjer bsgrub pa'i sbyang gzhi gdos bcas kyi lus dang*/ ngag dang*/

gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog la yod cing*/ de gsum gyi gnad rtsa rlung thig le gsum la yod pas/ rtsa skam 'chus dri can sogs su gyur pa dang*/ rlung zla nyi rang dbang du bgrod pas dbu ma'i longs spyod 'phrog pa dang*/ thig le dkar po thur dang dmar po gyen du phyogs te skyon tu gyur pa las ni nad dang rgas pa dang 'chi ba'i nyes pa skyed cing*/ rnal 'byor gyi stobs kyis rtsa dbu ma/ rlung mnyam rgyu/ thig le 'du 'phrod la gnad du bsnun pas/ bgrod pa gnyis po dbu ma'i longs spyod du gyur cing dpyid thig gong bur bcings/ grub pa'i dngul chus lcags 'bigs pa ltar lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum du sgyur bas rtsa thig rlung gi rnal 'byor 'chi med 'grub pa'i gsang lam yin pa'i rgyu mtshan de lta bu dang*/ 'chi ba slu ba la rlung gi rnal 'byor lhag par zab pa'i gnad gsang rang byung rgyal bas/ phyir 'gro 'phel bas 'chi ltas yin// nang du zin pas 'chi med 'grub// ces gsungs pa ltar/ las rlung dang ye rlung gnyis kyi ye shes rlung la cha gnyis su phye ba'i gcig gi nang du srog rlung gi nus pa bskyed cing*/ cha gcig las rlung dang 'dres pa'i tshul gyis nyin zhag rer drug brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga phyi rol tu rgyu ba de nyid 'phel na srog gi nus pa myur du 'dzad pa dang*/ zla nyi dag kyang yon por rgyus na 'chi bskyed la bum can sogs kyis nang du bzung bas ye rlung 'phel zhing ring du song bas las rlung dag ste rdo rje'i lus 'grub pa dang*/ kun rdzob kyi thig le ni chags pa'i 'pho ba can yin la ji tsam 'phos pa de tsam du tshe'i 'du byed bstungs shing chags bral 'pho med du bzhu btul byas pas dwangs ma stobs su gyur te don dam byang chub kyi sems brtan pas 'chi med ye shes kyi sku 'grub pa sogs rgyu mtshan shin tu mang mod kyi rgyas par ma spros la/

gong du smos pa rnams kyi zhar las kyang rtogs nus so// bcu gcig pa ni/ 'tsho thabs kyi cho ga de rnams shes pa kho nas phan pa ma mchis shing*/ sang bya gnang bya'ang mi tshe 'dzad pa'i rgyu yin pas 'phral la nyams su blang dgos te/ rtog pa las/ 'di na 'chi ba slu ba rnams// shin tu mang po shes nas kyang*// nyams ma blangs na mal du ni// bshad pas gos zhes khyod 'chi 'gyur// zhes dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi ni bstan bcos dang*// sbyor ba du ma shes nas kyang*// deng ngam sang ni bya'o zhes// sems bzhin du ni pha rol 'chi// zhes so// gang zhig 'bad na 'jig rten na mi 'grub pa'i dngos po ni 'ga' yang yod pa ma yin pas 'bad rtsol bya dgos te/ snga ma las/ stobs kyis 'bad pas dka' ba cung zad med// de bas rtsol ba'i khur ni 'dor mi bya// rtag tu 'bab na chu rgyun 'jam pos kyang*// dus su rdo leb dag kyang rnam par 'bigs// gtsubs na shing las me ni 'byung 'gyur zhing*// brkos par gyur na sa la chu 'byung 'gyur// mi yis rtsol ba byas na mi 'grub med// de 'dir 'os pa'i 'bad kun 'bras bur 'gyur// zhes so// khyad par shes rab rig pa'i gzhu la thabs mkhas mda'i 'phrul 'khor sbyar na dka' ba med par gnad du phigs par 'gyur te/ gang phyir rig pas thabs sbyar bas// dka' ba cung zad yod ma yin// nor bu sngags dang sman rnams kyi// mthu ni thams cad yang dag 'dod// ces so// 'on kyang bskyed sngags rlung gi rnal 'byor la sogs pa ni lan gcig tsam dang dus thung ngus 'bras bu chen po 'grub pa ma yin kyang yang dang yang du nyams su blangs pas 'dod pa'i don 'grub par 'gyur te/ gus pa la sogs khyad par gyis// rgyun tu bsgom pa gang gang yin// 'dod dang mya ngan la sogs pa'i// blo bzhin de de'i gsal snang 'byung*// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// bcu gnyis pa ni/ de ltar 'tsho ba ring du gnas pa la dgos pa ci yod snyam na/

nor bu zhes pa'i ming dang ldan pa tsam gyis mi chog ste yon tan tshang dgos/ de las 'dod pa 'jo ba bzhin du mtho ris kyi lus rten thob pa tsam gyis 'dod don mtha' dag mi 'grub pas mtho ris kyi yon tan dang ldan dgos/ mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun du grags pa'i gtso bo ni tshe ring ba nyid yin la/ tshe ring ba la brten nas 'jig rten gyi lugs dang dam pa'i chos kyi bya ba ci 'dod pa sgrub nus shing*/ de las mthar thug byang chub kyi go 'phang yang 'grub par 'gyur bas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don chen po dang ldan pa ste/ slob dpon gyis/ chos spyod dbang po dul ba ni// 'khor ba ru ni ji srid 'tsho// de srid bsod nams la sogs tshogs// byang chub sgrub byed rab tu skye// 'tsho ba las gzhan snying po ni// 'khor bar cung zad ma mthong ngo*// zhes gsungs so// bcu gsum pa 'bras bu la gnyis/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug go /dang po ni/ rin po che'i nus pas tshe bar bskal sogs su gnas pa klu'i rgyal po lta bu dang*/ bcud len gyi nus pas tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa slob dpon byā da li pa lta bu dang*/ srog gcod spangs pa sogs dkar po rnam par smin pas tshe lo dpag med nas khri la sogs par 'tsho ba lha dang 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po lta bu dang*/ rlung sbyor thun mong ba tsam gyis tshe lo brgya phrag mang por 'tsho ba ri rab kyi khong gseng la gnas pa'i drang srong la sogs pa lta bu 'tsho bas mi phongs shing dpal 'byor chen po la yun ring du longs spyod nus pa nyid do// gnyis pa ni/ bskyed rim dang bzlas pa mthar phyin pas lhag pa'i lha yis byin gyis brlabs te ji tsam 'dod kyi bar du 'tsho ba 'phags pa klu sgrub mi lo drug brgya bzhugs pas mtshon rgya bod kyi mkhas grub phal mo che lta bu dang*/ rtsa thig rlung gi rnal 'byor gyis dwangs ma stobs su gyur te 'dod gzugs gang rung gi rig pa 'dzin pa'i lus su gnas gyur te bskal pa la sogs par 'tsho zhing bzhugs pa grub chen klu'i byang chub lta bu dang*/

bskyed rdzogs cha mnyam du bsgoms pas rags pa'i phung khams dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor gnas gyur pa slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug lta bu dang*/ lus sems kyi 'pho ba mtha' dag zag med 'od gsal gyi dbyings su sbyangs pas rdo rje'i skus bskal pa ma stongs bar du bzhugs shing gzhan don mdzad pa sa ra ha dang*/ mi tra dzo ki la sogs pa bzhin lam legs par sbyangs pas 'chi med kyi sku 'grub ste don gnyis lhun grub kyi 'khor los sgyur ba ni rgya bod gnyis su ches mang po byung zhing 'byung bar 'gyur ba nyid do// de'ang rtsa thig rlung gsum sku gsung thugs rdo rjer sbyangs nas ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bor ro mnyam pa mthar thug gi 'chi med rnam gsum 'grub par 'gyur ba ste/ sems sgrib bral du dag pas thugs rdo rje dus gsum mnyam nyid kyi chos sku sems 'chi med dang*/ ngag sgrib bral du dag pas gsung rdo rje zab gsal dbyer med kyi longs skus gzhom med bde bas mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa ngag 'chi med dang*/ lus sgrib bral du dag pas sku rdo rje kun khyab sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sprul skus gang 'dul gyi rol pa ston pa lus 'chi med de sku dang ye shes kyi rol pa chen por mngon par rdzogs shing byang chub par 'gyur la/ de bas na 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe sgrub pa la nan tan tu bya'o// //len pa'i rnam shes kha lo sgyur ba yis// rig pa'i skyes bu srid 'dir bslus pa la// thar dang mtho ris bde bar ngal 'tsho ba'i// rten 'di ring du 'tsho las don chen gang*// spang blang shes shing thabs kyang ma 'gag la// de blo sbyor ba'i lam la mi 'jug na// kim pa'i 'bras bzhin dgos dus mi bstangs pas// grogs dag rnam par rig pa su yis brkus// 'tsho thabs nyi zla'i sgron me thogs bzhin tu// de ni btang snyoms mal du mi mnal bar// 'chi bdag mun rum bskrad nas sa steng du// don gnyis snang ba sbar ba'i dus ni 'di// rgyal bas yid bzhin nor bu'i mchog nyid du// bsngags pa'i ljags brkyang lha las lhag pa'i rten// cho ga'i mthu las rdo rje'i srog 'grub ste// grub gnyis char pas skye dgu 'tsho byed shog

/ces pa 'di'ang thams cad mkhyen gzigs rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhal snga nas bka' stsal gnang ba gtsug tu mchod de snyom las pa karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs yang dben kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du bris pa dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi zhabs pad rdo rje ltar brtan cing 'gro ba mtha' yas pa 'chi bdag gi g.yul las rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
